about_the_game:
Introduction to the Game

Development Team: Jinbu Simu Studio. Xiaohongshu: Jinbu Simu Studio

Planner/Programmer: Qingtong (QQ: 3931837109). Screenwriter: Yanxi. Artist: Queen Astarte. Scene Designer: Sen

QQ Group Number: 967972685. QR code for the 内测 QQ group can be seen in the picture.

In the prosperous Donghua Country, the Xunlong Technology Company, which seemingly sells intelligent cleaning products advocating environmentalism, is actually the Xunlong Division that expels evil spirits. The employees of the company are ostensibly cleaners, but secretly they are Exorcists, responsible for eliminating the "Evil Creatures". Exorcists possess the superhuman ability "Spiritual Realm", and according to their ability levels, they can create their own spaces. Meanwhile, the Evil Creatures can also create terrifying and strange Inner Worlds, which are gradually infiltrating the ordinary lives of humans.

The player will play as the protagonist Tang Huan, who has just finished the college entrance examination. Tang Huan is an 18-year-old female. After the painful and long college entrance examination, she unfortunately learns the sad news of her mother's death. At the desolate funeral, only her uncle Yun Bai is with her. Her mother's unknown origin and the missing body weave a strange mystery. Immersed in grief, Tang Huan decides to move away from this sad place. On the last day when she shared beautiful memories with her mother, Tang Huan accidentally enters the Inner World. The once normal house is turned into an upside-down room. She gets to know a talking rabbit doll, the inverted Xunlong Technology cleaner 'Luosha', and a noisy and proud cat.

Gameplay

  • Exploration and Puzzle-solving: A side-scrolling exploration and puzzle-solving game. Solve the tough puzzles in the game according to the clues provided.

  • Core Ability: "Colorful Mirage": Reasonably utilize Tang Huan's ability "Colorful Mirage", which is a personal domain that creates illusions using memories. Explore the scene, solve puzzles, and search for the "Memory Shackles" based on the memories of the Evil Creatures. Put on the mysterious Jinbu Simu mask and place the "Memory Shackles" in the appropriate position to condense. Depending on the player's choices, it will either condense the evil Wenyu that erases the existence of the Evil Creatures painfully and distortedly, or condense the beautiful Wenyu that purifies the Evil Creatures.

  • Xunlong Technology Employee Investigation Terminal: Explore the strange supernatural events caused by different Evil Creatures, the main storyline, and rich and interesting side investigation tasks. Earn investigation coins and rose coins according to the investigation tasks, and shuttle back and forth between the beautiful real world and the Inner World. The level of horror is determined by the player. You can choose to condense the dark Wenyu and degenerate into a bloody and terrifying Inner World to experience thrilling chase battles, or condense the beautiful Wenyu to weave a peaceful and beautiful Inner World.

  • Encounters: Currently, players can court one female character (Lanfu) and one male character ('Luosha'). The plot tends to be CB (companion-based, friendship-oriented), and at the same time, you can also develop the favorability with other characters. The favorability with different characters will also lead to different endings.

Game Process

  • Game Duration: The DEMO version is Chapter 1, with a playtime of 1 - 2 hours. The complete version is expected to be about 6 hours.

  • DEMO Version Description: The DEMO version is not the official Chapter 1. The current materials and walking maps have not been fully drawn yet, and the lacking interactive content in the DEMO will be supplemented later. After joining the Xunlong Technology Company in Chapter 2, you will be able to use the investigation terminal. The investigation terminal obtained in the current DEMO version is only for preview and is not the effect of the official version.

Welcome to feedback BUGs. You can post them in the QQ group (QQ group number: 967972685) or privately message the group owner (planner) Qingtong (QQ account: 3931837109). Thank you for playing.
